plugins.name: llm-wiki-for-code
plugins.description: Maintains a structured code wiki in code-docs/ to reduce token usage in Claude Code sessions. Auto-updates after every file edit via PostToolUse hook.

plugins.name: spec-driven
plugins.description: Skills for repositories that write their decisions down. Ships conformance-review (citation-required review of uncommitted changes against the repo's specs, issues, ADRs, glossary, and standing rules) and prove-it-works (evidence-based verification that branch work actually runs, chaining into conformance-review on failure).
